text: Delivered docs/plans/one-shot-mvpa.md. The plan selects a Gale-backed LSS TrialReadout, a generic MVPA PatternOperator, and a new mvpa-fit bridge; separates temporal nuisance, foldwise trial-feature adjustment, and conditional prediction control; stages ridge, soft logistic, multivar soft LDA, covariance-aware ITEM-like integration, then latent EM; and defines JVM/JS laws, differential/metamorphic/adversarial/leakage/simulation/performance gates. Verified internal links, 30-candidate audit, no trailing whitespace, and clean diff whitespace check. No code or sbt tests were required for the documentation-only slice.
